==Classification==
This argument may have been had before, but, does this belong under Talents? I dunno, Fortelling is a talent, as well as being able to Heal very well. But anyone strong enough seems to be able to to this, Messana(sp?) says in the White Tower, "You are very weak child, but you have just strength enough" and then Alviarin was shown how to travel. Thoughts? -- [[User:Elliot N|Elliot N]] 17:23, 26 April 2006 (UTC)

: A very late reply, but this probably belongs under Talents, as it has been shown several times in the last few books that skill in forming Gateways varies wildly between channelers. In addition, it seems closely linked to Skimming (it is mentioned at least once that once you reach your destination, you weave another Gateway - although this might be a continuity error), meaning that at least two weaves will potentially fall under the Traveling umbrella.

: Hopefully there's some kind of official confirmation floating around, though. [[User:Whitecroc|Whitecroc]] 21:29, April 4, 2011 (UTC)

== Lost since the Breaking ==

I seem to recall one of the characters suggesting (or it was mentioned in a glossary) that the Queen of Manetheren may have used Traveling prior to committing suicide, suggesting the ability was lost during the [[Trolloc Wars]]. Am I imagining this? It seems possible that the weave survived for that long, considering how it's constantly hinted that the world was very different during the AB years. Or maybe I'm just lost in my own theories. Blargh. [[User:Whitecroc|Whitecroc]] 21:34, April 4, 2011 (UTC)
